skill.name: faceless-explainer
skill.description: Create faceless explainer videos from articles, notes, topics, or briefs with HyperFrames. The skill plans the story, adopts a visual preset, generates audio and captions, builds animated HTML frames, assembles the video, and renders an MP4.
skill.summary: Builds captioned faceless explainer videos from text using HyperFrames story, design, audio, and render steps.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, regular expression .exec() calls, fixed relative references, or expected local project file I/O. Confirmed risks remain: an environment-controlled audio engine is executed with spawnSync, initialization may update global skills from GitHub, generated HTML loads GSAP from a CDN, and the workflow depends on a hidden HeyGen credential. No prompt-injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the HF_MEDIA_ENGINE executable override or restrict it to an allowlisted, signed, local engine path before calling spawnSync.

remediation.issue: Global skill auto-update during project initialization
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before updating global skills from GitHub, or separate update behavior from project initialization.

remediation.issue: Remote CDN script in generated HTML
remediation.suggestion: Bundle and pin GSAP locally, or enforce integrity checks and version pinning for any remote script dependency.
Document the credential access clearly, request user consent before audio retrieval, and avoid copying credentials into project files.

content.value_statement: Turning raw notes into an animated explainer requires story, design, audio, and render coordination. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through a HyperFrames workflow for faceless videos with invented visuals.
actual_capabilities: Initializes a HyperFrames project and stores the source text as a synthetic capture package.
Builds frame.md from a selected creative preset and optional brand tokens.
Drafts STORYBOARD.md and SCRIPT.md for approved frame-by-frame explainer planning.
Runs audio, duration sync, sound effect, caption, transition, and index assembly scripts.
Dispatches per-frame workers to create self-contained HTML compositions.
Runs lint, validation, inspection, snapshots, preview, and final MP4 rendering through HyperFrames.
limitations: Requires the HyperFrames CLI, sibling HyperFrames skills, and Node.js scripts.
Uses external commands and may use HeyGen credentials for audio when available.
Does not capture real websites, product tours, or existing footage.
Needs user approval at storyboard and final review gates before rendering.

use_cases.title: Educator Concept Video
use_cases.description: Convert a topic or lesson note into a short animated explainer with narration, captions, and invented diagrams.

use_cases.title: Article Repurposing
use_cases.description: Turn a long article into a focused social or training video without relying on website capture or stock footage.

use_cases.title: Internal Training Explainer
use_cases.description: Create a concise process video from internal notes, with a storyboard gate before production starts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Short Topic Explainer
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a simple topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60-second faceless explainer about compound interest for beginners. Use clear narration, simple diagrams, and a calm visual style.

prompt_templates.title: Turn Notes Into a Storyboard
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these notes to draft a frame-by-frame faceless explainer. Keep the video under 90 seconds, identify the audience, and ask for approval before building frames.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Narrated Process Video
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate production request for a how-to.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a narrated how-to explainer from this process brief. Use an ordered visual stage, generate captions, and keep each step visually distinct.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Complete Approved Render
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete faceless explainer from this source text. Use portrait format, follow the approval gates, run validation and inspection, then render the final MP4 after approval.

output_examples.input: Explain compound interest to teenagers in one minute.
output_examples.output: A 7-frame storyboard using a snowball metaphor, a short narration script, generated captions, animated diagram frames, and a final MP4 path.

output_examples.input: Turn this article about recycling myths into a 45-second social video.
output_examples.output: A compressed teaching arc with a statistic hook, three myth-versus-reality frames, caption timing, transitions, and a reviewable HyperFrames preview.

output_examples.input: Make an internal explainer for our new reimbursement process.
output_examples.output: A step-by-step process video plan with simple invented visuals, voiceover timing, caption-safe layouts, and render checks before final export.

best_practices: Confirm the topic, audience, length, aspect ratio, and language before generating files.
Review and approve the storyboard before audio and frame production begin.
Keep visuals faceless by using typography, diagrams, abstract graphics, and data views.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for website tours, product launch promos, pull requests, or existing footage captions.
Do not skip approval gates when the storyboard or final preview needs user review.
Do not place key frame content in the bottom caption band.

faq.question: What does faceless mean in this skill?
faq.answer: It means the video uses invented visuals such as type, diagrams, charts, and abstract motion instead of filmed people.

faq.question: Can it use a real image that I provide?
faq.answer: Yes. A user-supplied image can be placed under the project public folder and referenced in the relevant frame.

faq.question: Does it capture websites or product interfaces?
faq.answer: No. It creates a synthetic capture package from text and routes website or product work to other HyperFrames skills.

faq.question: Does it generate narration and captions?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow includes audio generation or fallback handling, duration sync, caption building, and caption-safe layouts.

faq.question: What tools are required?
faq.answer: The workflow expects Node.js, the HyperFrames CLI, related HyperFrames skills, and optional HeyGen access for media services.

faq.question: Can it run without signing in to HeyGen?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs the agent to show sign-in status and continue offline when the user chooses that route.
